title: Current federal Members of Parliament in Canada
scope: Members of the House of Commons of Canada who hold a seat in the federal Parliament as of the research date. Excludes provincial and territorial legislatures, municipal bodies, and Senators.

sections.title: Sitting federal MPs by electoral district
sections.question: Who holds each House of Commons seat as a sitting Member of Parliament, and which party is each member affiliated with?
sections.unit: sitting Member of Parliament holding a House of Commons seat as of the as-of date

fields.name: member_name
fields.meaning: Full name of the sitting Member of Parliament as published by the House of Commons or Elections Canada.
fields.absence_meaning: Unknown if no authoritative source names the holder; absence of a name means the seat has no sitting member, which must be recorded as a vacancy rather than an entry.

fields.name: electoral_district
fields.meaning: Official name of the federal electoral district (riding) the member represents.
fields.absence_meaning: Unknown if the district cannot be determined from authoritative sources; an entry without a district cannot be placed in the report.

fields.name: party_affiliation
fields.meaning: Recognized party the member sits with as of the as-of date, as published by the House of Commons.
fields.absence_meaning: Explicitly absent if the member sits as an independent; unknown if the affiliation has not been verified.

evidence_requirements: Each entry must cite an authoritative source (House of Commons or Elections Canada) showing the member holds the district seat on the as-of date.
Each party affiliation must be confirmed against a source dated on or near the as-of date.

interpretation_notes: "Current" is interpreted as holding a House of Commons seat on the research date 2026-10-28.
Vacant seats are not report entries; they are recorded only in the supporting coverage check.
Senators and provincial or municipal representatives are out of scope.

completion_checks.description: Every House of Commons seat with a sitting member on the as-of date appears exactly once in the G1 records.
completion_checks.measurement_method: Reconcile the list of sitting members against the official House of Commons list and Elections Canada district list for the as-of date, checking for duplicates and omissions.
limitations: Mid-term changes such as by-elections, resignations or floor crossings may occur near the as-of date.
completion_checks.unit: sitting Member of Parliament holding a House of Commons seat as of the as-of date
evidence_required: Official House of Commons member list dated on or near the as-of date

completion_checks.description: Seats with no sitting member on the as-of date are identified so that vacancies are not confused with entries.
completion_checks.measurement_method: Compare the total set of federal electoral districts with the set of seats that have a sitting member and list any remaining districts as vacant or unresolved.
limitations: Vacancy status may change quickly around by-elections.
completion_checks.unit: federal electoral district seat, whether occupied or vacant
evidence_required: Elections Canada list of electoral districts
Source documenting any vacancies as of the as-of date
